title: REACTION: Machado's Return to Venezuela Set to Test Democratic Transition
gist: María Corina Machado returned to Venezuela on October 25, 2026, after almost 11 months abroad, raising pressure for early elections in a U.S.-supervised transition following Maduro's January capture. Analysts (Alarcón, Oliveros, Arreaza of Barclays) see the political transition lagging the economic one, with Machado's return potentially accelerating elections, while risks include regime reprisal, social unrest and constraints on debt restructuring.
